name: Amy's Kitchen Gluten Free Rice Macaroni & Cheese
whyItWorks: Organic tender white rice macaroni baked in a traditional aged cheddar cheese sauce. With only 1g fiber and no wheat gluten, it satisfies comfort food cravings without mechanical roughage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Microwave for 4 minutes or bake in oven. Take a lactase tablet if sensitive to dairy cheese.
watchOuts: Contains real cheddar cheese and butter; take lactase if lactose intolerant.
